description: This file defines a React component 'HoverPopover' that provides a customizable hover-based popover using the '@radix-ui/react-hover-card' library. It manages properties for content, children, arrow display, alignment, and delay, encapsulating Radix UI's hover card functionality.

methods.name: HoverPopover
methods.description: A React functional component that renders a hover-activated popover using Radix UI components with customizable properties.
